name: The Shops at Atlas Park
summary: Shopping mall featuring a landscaped courtyard bordered by stores, eateries & a multiplex cinema.
description: The Shops at Atlas Park, located in Glendale, New York, unfortunately has a website that appears to have been compromised or taken over by unrelated gambling content. Based on the legitimate shopping center name and location at 80-00 Cooper Avenue, this property was originally developed as a neighborhood shopping destination serving the Glendale community in Queens. The center was designed to provide convenient retail access to local residents with a mix of stores and services. While the current website does not reflect the actual shopping center operations, Atlas Park has historically served as a community gathering place for Queens residents. The property represents the type of neighborhood retail development common in New York City's outer boroughs, offering practical shopping options within residential areas.
